protocol.description: Compound v2 fork lending protocol on BNB Chain (BSC) — the largest BSC lending venue. Operates a Core Pool (multi-asset shared-liquidity Compound-style) and Isolated Pools (per-asset risk segregation). Includes XVS governance token with LayerZero OFT bridge across 7 chains, ResilientOracle multi-source price aggregator, ACM (Access Control Manager), Diamond Comptroller, and VAI overcollateralized stablecoin.
